sources.entry: Snagit - Screen Capture and Recording Software. Simple and Powerful.

summary.name: Snagit
summary.one_liner: Snagit is TechSmith's screen capture and recording software for creating annotated screenshots, screen videos, and step-by-step visual guides on Windows and macOS.
use_cases: Capturing entire scrolling web pages or spreadsheets in one image
Creating step-by-step process documentation and software tutorials
Annotating screenshots with arrows and callouts
Recording quick screen walkthroughs with microphone and webcam
Redacting sensitive information before sharing screenshots
Building onboarding and training materials for teams
summary.what_it_does: Snagit captures screens as images, including scrolling captures that stitch long pages or spreadsheets into a single image. It lets users add arrows, callouts, text, and markup to captures, and includes a smart redact feature to hide sensitive information. Users can record screen video with microphone, system audio, and webcam, then trim clips or reduce background noise. Its step capture mode records clicks and generates sequential guides with screenshots, and captures can be shared through a single click, hosted on Screencast, or sent to other destinations.
notable: Scrolling capture of entire web pages, documents, and spreadsheets in one image
Step capture that automatically generates sequential guides from clicks
Smart redact to identify and hide sensitive information
Themes to apply team colors and fonts to captures
caveats: Volume discounts for teams start at five licenses; current pricing is on a separate Teams & Business page
Page says a full Camtasia plan is needed for advanced video editing and audio polish beyond Snagit
Some features and formats are export-only (PDF, CUR, EPS)
